atlas:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original production sprite atlas for MOKSHA, a SIDE-ON 2D cyberpunk action game.
Create one square transparent PNG sprite sheet containing EXACTLY TWELVE separate reusable environment objects in a strictly ordered 4-column by 3-row grid. Each object wholly inside its own cell with a large fully transparent gutter, no labels, no gridlines, no background, no shadows on a background. True alpha transparency outside objects, including all corners. Not a mockup.
Camera: straight-on flat side view, only a tiny top lip on platforms, NO ISOMETRIC projection, no dramatic perspective. Every object isolated and complete, never touching another object.
A cohesive rain-worn inhabited future-city industrial set: oil-blue shadows (#142533), petrol-teal metal (#31545b), oxidized rust/copper (#8b5540), desaturated concrete (#687073), a few restrained warm amber light pixels (#d6a267). Premium detailed hand-placed pixel-art look, crisp square pixel clusters, strong silhouettes at low resolution, sharp dark outlines, realistic mechanical wear, scratches, grime, rivets, leaks. Think densely lived-in future city, not neon rainbow, not fantasy.
Exact left-to-right order:
ROW 1: (1) long low pavement foundation segment, flat level straight walkable upper edge, segmented dark concrete slab with thin teal steel curb, wide 8:1 aspect; (2) thin raised steel walkway ledge with horizontal upper edge and two short under-braces, wide 7:1 aspect; (3) upright exterior wall panel, patched rain-stained concrete with worn service hatch and modest cable conduit, rectangular 4:5 aspect; (4) long narrow storm-drain grille viewed from the side, horizontal wide 6:1 aspect.
ROW 2: (5) squat rectangular reinforced cargo crate, closed, rust-orange/blue metal, nearly square front face; (6) upright cylindrical coolant drum, muted teal with rusty ribs and small pale label, tall 2:3 aspect; (7) portable short handled fuel canister with slanted top and cap, copper/rust metal, tall 2:3 aspect; (8) tall narrow municipal electrical utility cabinet with one amber status LED, worn teal front, tall 3:5 aspect.
ROW 3: (9) exposed horizontal rusty pipe assembly with one elbow and two mounting brackets, 3:1 aspect; (10) one slender tall streetlamp with a bent horizontal light arm near top, amber rectangular emitter, narrow 1:3 aspect, full base visible; (11) horizontal rectangular abstract amber/teal service sign with only a simple geometric nonverbal icon, no readable letters, wide 2:1 aspect; (12) a horizontal hanging bundle of slack black/teal utility cables, two end brackets, loops and clipped connectors, wide 4:1 aspect.
Fill each cell enough to show material detail. Pixels, NOT a vector illustration. No people, no floors beneath props, no landscape, no checkerboard drawn into the image, no text, no watermark, no magical runes, no flames, no weapons. Original designs.
background:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original 2D SIDE-ON video game background plate for MOKSHA, wide 16:9 landscape, no transparency.
Draw the backdrop of a rain-worn, densely inhabited modern-future industrial residential district at blue-hour night. Flat SIDE-ON elevation along a city street, not looking down an alley. A looming monolithic corporate tower rises slightly right of center behind tired apartment blocks and utility architecture. Human-scale balconies, air-conditioning units, repeating windows, pipes, aerials and suspended wires communicate a real lived-in place. No people or vehicles. No foreground ground, sidewalk, platform, curb or walkable floor: this is ONLY the distant architecture and cloudy sky backdrop that will sit behind separate game terrain. Buildings continue to the bottom edge, no perspective street or vanishing point.
Style: rich detailed pixel-art background designed to remain readable when shown at 640×360. Disciplined square pixel clusters, dithered atmospheric haze. Oil-blue shadows (#142533), petrol-teal/pale industrial blue highlights (#31545b), quiet rust copper structural details, restrained amber windows. Layer silhouettes by depth: nearly obscured tower and distant city, darker low-detail foreground building elevations near the left and right edges, lower contrast center for game characters later. The scene has moody wet air, but no rain streak overlay. Sparing lit windows and teal/amber abstract signs, no legible text, no magical neon, no rainbow.
Composition: cinematic wide environment art, melancholy ordinary human city before powers. No isometric camera, no diagonal ground planes, no fantasy, no gothic ornament, no flames, no characters, no user interface, no title, no logos, no watermark. Original architecture. Let the image fill the whole wide canvas with no border.
